messages:
maria: New idea: ‘dense-scan’ org layout that shows many projects as micro-cards + a persistent invoice flyout in the header. Goal: let admins scan 50+ projects quickly but still get easy CSV downloads. Fig: https://figma.com/… :telescope:

jonah: micro-cards look great for bulk scanning. Concern: token detail becomes unreadable at micro scale. Suggest hiding per-project detail behind a short inline row or a small flyout anchor.

rebecca: perf reality: returning day-level token arrays for 50 projects kills payload. Plan: API returns totals + tiny sparkline (svg or compressed data), and /projects/:id/usage-days for detail fetched on demand. Use IntersectionObserver at 300px and keyboard focus to prefetch.

sam-a11y: accessibility checklist: micro-cards must still be keyboard operable. Implement roving tabindex for arrow keys and tab-out behavior. If we use a header flyout for invoices, it must be role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and focus-trapped. Color contrast: our orange decrease pill is 3.0:1  needs to be darker or paired with an icon to avoid color-only cues.

leah: CS input: people lose the download button after switching scopes. Make header flyout the canonical place for "Download invoice (CSV, YYYY-MM)" and add a tiny per-card link labeled "CSV" for quick single-project downloads. Also include timeframe in the CTA.

oliver: product decision: header flyout = canonical + micro-links in cards. Analytics: single event name invoice_download with properties {scope_type, scope_id, project_id|null, timeframe}. noah, is that ok?

noah-analytics: yes — use event invoice_download and include scope_name and scope_type. For header clicks set project_id=null. Also track source: header|card. We'll dedupe in analysis by preferring the first event for a session.

maria: UX question: inline expand vs flyout for token rows. Which preserves layout best?

jonah: inline expand causes layout shift and pushes cards down. Flyout keeps grid stable but adds a step. Hybrid: inline for <=5 rows, flyout when >5. Client can decide based on X-Total-Count header.

rebecca: backend will include X-Total-Count on /projects/:id/usage-days and add ?prefetch=focus param. Also support ?compact=1 to return compressed payload for sparklines. We'll paginate large lists.

sam-a11y: announce strings: "Token details expanded for <project>" and "Token details closed for <project>". For flyout header use "Token details dialog for <project>, <N> entries". Provide copy for screenreader-only hints.

jonah: visual polish: micro-card cost should be bold, 14px; token count small muted text. Delta pill show arrow + color; add tooltip explaining delta calc: "percentage vs previous period".

leah: copy tweak: change label to "Estimated charges (period)" and tooltip "Includes model and infra charges, not including taxes." Also update support KB snippet with steps to find CSV after scope switch.

maria: experiment proposal: roll dense-scan to 3% of orgs behind flag dense_scan_layout. Metrics: invoice downloads per visit, avg projects in viewport, page TTI, and support ticket volume. Ship prototype by Fri, dev spike next week.

oliver: sounds good. timeline +1. Rebecca please add feature flag and payload limits. Jonah update Figma and include keyboard flow.

rebecca: will add flag dense_scan_layout, implement prefetch behavior, and add skeleton placeholders for sparklines to avoid CLS.

noah-analytics: I'll prepare dashboard for experiment metrics and ensure event schema is in our tracking repo.

maria: thanks everyone. If no objections I'll lock requirements today and start the prototype run. :rocket:
